lore.modestmining.flint_mattock: A pickaxe knapped from Flint. It can mine stone and coal, but nothing tougher. Too crude to be enchanted.
lore.modestmining.flint_spade: A shovel knapped from Flint. Too crude to be enchanted.
lore.modestmining.flint_hatchet: An axe knapped from Flint, needed to fell your first trees. Small enough to craft without a Crafting Table. Too crude to be enchanted.
lore.modestmining.flint_hoe: A hoe knapped from Flint. Too crude to be enchanted.
lore.modestmining.flint_blade: A sword knapped from Flint. Too crude to be enchanted.
lore.modestmining.bronze_pickaxe: A pickaxe of Bronze, an alloy of Copper and Tin made in a Forge. It can mine Iron, but not Gold, Diamond, or Flux.
lore.modestmining.bronze_shovel: A sturdy tool of Bronze, an alloy of Copper and Tin made in a Forge.
lore.modestmining.bronze_axe: A sturdy tool of Bronze, an alloy of Copper and Tin made in a Forge.
lore.modestmining.bronze_hoe: A sturdy tool of Bronze, an alloy of Copper and Tin made in a Forge.
lore.modestmining.bronze_sword: A sturdy sword of Bronze, an alloy of Copper and Tin made in a Forge.
lore.modestmining.bronze_knife: A knife of Bronze, an alloy of Copper and Tin made in a Forge. Knives cut ingredients on a Cutting Board and harvest Straw from grasses.
lore.modestmining.bronze_helmet: Armor of Bronze, an alloy of Copper and Tin made in a Forge.
lore.modestmining.bronze_chestplate: Armor of Bronze, an alloy of Copper and Tin made in a Forge.
lore.modestmining.bronze_leggings: Armor of Bronze, an alloy of Copper and Tin made in a Forge.
lore.modestmining.bronze_boots: Armor of Bronze, an alloy of Copper and Tin made in a Forge.
lore.modestmining.prismarite_pickaxe: A Prismarite tool forged from Gold, a Pearl, and Prismarine. It can mine anything a Diamond tool can.
lore.modestmining.prismarite_shovel: A Prismarite tool forged from Gold, a Pearl, and Prismarine. It can mine anything a Diamond tool can.
lore.modestmining.prismarite_axe: A Prismarite tool forged from Gold, a Pearl, and Prismarine. It can mine anything a Diamond tool can.
lore.modestmining.prismarite_hoe: A Prismarite tool forged from Gold, a Pearl, and Prismarine. It can mine anything a Diamond tool can.
lore.modestmining.prismarite_sword: A Prismarite sword forged from Gold, a Pearl, and Prismarine.
lore.modestmining.prismarite_knife: A Prismarite knife forged from Gold, a Pearl, and Prismarine. Knives cut ingredients on a Cutting Board and harvest Straw from grasses.
lore.modestmining.prismarite_helmet: Prismarite armor that shields its wearer from a quarter of all magic damage.
lore.modestmining.prismarite_chestplate: Prismarite armor that shields its wearer from a quarter of all magic damage.
lore.modestmining.prismarite_leggings: Prismarite armor that makes its wearer swim 50% faster.
lore.modestmining.prismarite_boots: Prismarite armor that makes its wearer swim 50% faster.
lore.modestmining.valkyrium_pickaxe: A Valkyrium tool forged from Gold, Silver, and Meteoric Scrap. It can mine anything a Diamond tool can.
lore.modestmining.valkyrium_shovel: A Valkyrium tool forged from Gold, Silver, and Meteoric Scrap. It can mine anything a Diamond tool can.
lore.modestmining.valkyrium_axe: A Valkyrium tool forged from Gold, Silver, and Meteoric Scrap. It can mine anything a Diamond tool can.
lore.modestmining.valkyrium_hoe: A Valkyrium tool forged from Gold, Silver, and Meteoric Scrap. It can mine anything a Diamond tool can.
lore.modestmining.valkyrium_sword: A Valkyrium sword forged from Gold, Silver, and Meteoric Scrap.
lore.modestmining.valkyrium_knife: A Valkyrium knife forged from Gold, Silver, and Meteoric Scrap. Knives cut ingredients on a Cutting Board and harvest Straw from grasses.
lore.modestmining.valkyrium_helmet: Light Valkyrium armor forged from Gold, Silver, and Meteoric Scrap.
lore.modestmining.valkyrium_chestplate: Light Valkyrium armor forged from Gold, Silver, and Meteoric Scrap.
lore.modestmining.valkyrium_leggings: Valkyrium armor that makes its wearer move 25% faster.
lore.modestmining.valkyrium_boots: Valkyrium armor that makes its wearer move 25% faster.

lore.modestmining.wooden_javelin: A spear that can be hurled at enemies by holding and releasing use. Pick it back up where it lands.

lore.modestmining.forge: A fuelled workstation for smelting alloys and forging tools, armor, and metalwork. Some recipes need hotter fuels like Coke.
lore.modestmining.coke: A hot-burning fuel forged from Coal and Netherrack. Needed for the Forge's toughest recipes.
lore.modestmining.coke_block: A solid block of Coke. Burns for a very long time.
lore.modestmining.coke_chunk: A small piece of Coke, for when a whole lump is too much. Eight make a full piece.
lore.modestmining.coal_chunk: A small piece of Coal, for when a whole lump is too much. Eight make a full piece.
lore.modestmining.charcoal_chunk: A small piece of Charcoal, for when a whole lump is too much. Eight make a full piece.
lore.modestmining.meteorite: A chunk of space rock that crashes into mountains, hills, badlands, deserts, and plains, leaving a crater. Smelt it into Meteoric Scrap.
lore.modestmining.meteoric_scrap: Strange metal smelted from a Meteorite. Forged with Gold and Silver to make Valkyrium.
lore.modestmining.clam: A giant clam found on the floor of cold and frozen oceans. Break it with a Chisel to pry out a Pearl, or use Silk Touch to keep it.
lore.modestmining.pearl: A lustrous gem pried from a Clam with a Chisel. Forged with Gold and Prismarine to make Prismarite.
lore.modestmining.shell: A seashell found on beaches or dropped by Clams. Mill it into Bone Meal.
lore.modestmining.flesh: Rotten Flesh that has been smelted clean. Craft it into Leather.
lore.modestmining.copper_screw: An old Copper screw sometimes brushed out of Suspicious Sand and Gravel. Used to make Chisels.
lore.modestmining.amethyst: A compressed cluster of nine Amethyst Shards. Used to make Chisels.
lore.modestmining.diamond_shard: A ninth of a Diamond. Nine shards can be put back together into a whole Diamond.
lore.modestmining.diamond_shard_block: A solid block of Diamond Shards.
lore.modestmining.lead_ore: An ore that can be mined with a Copper Pickaxe or better to collect Raw Lead. It's more common in swamps.
lore.modestmining.deepslate_lead_ore: An ore that can be mined with a Copper Pickaxe or better to collect Raw Lead. It's more common in swamps.
lore.modestmining.nether_lead_ore: A Nether ore that can be mined with a Copper Pickaxe or better to collect Raw Lead Nuggets.
lore.modestmining.raw_lead: A chunk of raw ore that can be smelted into a Lead Ingot.
lore.modestmining.lead_ingot: A heavy, dense metal used for weighty equipment and machinery.
lore.modestmining.lead_nugget: A small piece of Lead that can be combined into an ingot.
lore.modestmining.electrum_ingot: An alloy of Gold and Silver made in a Forge.
lore.modestmining.electrum_nugget: A small piece of Electrum that can be combined into an ingot.
lore.modestmining.prismarite_ingot: An ocean metal forged from Gold, a Pearl, and Prismarine. Its armor speeds up swimming and wards off magic.
lore.modestmining.prismarite_nugget: A small piece of Prismarite that can be combined into an ingot.
lore.modestmining.valkyrium_ingot: A sky metal forged from Gold, Silver, and Meteoric Scrap. Its armor makes you fleet of foot.
lore.modestmining.valkyrium_nugget: A small piece of Valkyrium that can be combined into an ingot.
